<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state(fr):
    seg=fr.segmentation['nodes']
    d={}; bar=None
    for nd in seg:
        bnd=nd['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in bnd); r1=max(p[0] for p in bnd)
        c0=min(p[1] for p in bnd); c1=max(p[1] for p in bnd)
        if 47<=r0<=63 and 22<=c0<=38 and nd['color'] in ('W','N','g','S','b'):
            row=(r0-48)//5; col=(c0-23)//5
            d.setdefault(nd['color'],[]).append((row,col))
        if nd['color']=='g' and 17<=r0<=23 and c0<=20 and nd['pixels']>30:
            bar=c1
    return {k:sorted(v) for k,v in d.items()}, bar
print("start:",state(current_frame))
# Probe color cycle: click center (N), top-center (W), top-left (g)
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':55,'col':30}])
print("click center(N) 55,30:",state(current_frame))
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':50,'col':30}])
print("click top-center(W) 50,30:",state(current_frame))
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':50,'col':25}])
print("click top-left(g) 50,25:",state(current_frame))
</parameter>
